Custom development and integration

More than 50 quotes a day, ready in minutes.

ADS Mexicana replaced manual quoting with a custom tool integrated into HubSpot.

Cloudfianz's work
Custom quoting tool
Connected platform
HubSpot
Implementation
One year, from assessment to launch

The client

ADS manufactures corrugated high-density polyethylene pipes and stormwater, sanitary and electrical management solutions. It serves projects in Mexico and Central America, operating four plants and four distribution centers.

The challenge

Quoting and recording were two separate jobs

The team used Excel to quote a broad product catalog. Prices, discounts, recommendations and technical formulas were applied manually. Product and client information was isolated, with no workflow connecting the data.

Once the proposal was ready, it still had to be recorded to preserve history. Besides delaying sales responses, the process relied on each person remembering and correctly applying business rules.

The technical decision

Choose a solution covering ADS's rules

Assess quoting rules

Cloudfianz mapped the sales process, calculation formulas and quoting criteria. HubSpot's native quoting tool was evaluated but could not represent the complexity of the catalog and internal rules.

Extend the existing platform

An external panel connected to HubSpot, which ADS already used, was chosen. The solution met the need without upgrading the HubSpot plan or adding licenses for that functionality.

The solution

An extension of the sales process

Proposals that once took one to several hours are now prepared in minutes, with calculation rules applied automatically. The sales team creates more than 50 quotes a day through the solution.

The quoting tool integrates with HubSpot and automatically loads deal, company and associated contact data. The catalog uses HubSpot products, and the tool also supports importing complete catalogs via CSV files.

The panel applies ADS's own calculations: pricing rules, discounts and recommendations. At completion, it creates the quote in HubSpot and links it to the relevant deal.

  • Data available from the start

    The salesperson uses client and deal information already in the CRM.

  • Consistent calculations

    Rules run inside the tool without manually repeating formulas.

  • Automatic recording

    The proposal is linked to the deal without a second entry to preserve history.

  • Connected catalog

    Products, companies, contacts and quotes are part of the same sales workflow.

Development tailored to the sales process.

The project took one year from assessment to full launch.

The results

More than 50quotes per day

From hours of calculation to proposals in minutes

Quote in minutes and preserve history

The quoting tool became the sales team's main tool, with more than 50 daily quotes. A process that once took one to several hours is completed in minutes, with rules applied consistently to every proposal.

More time for sales work

Information is no longer isolated and every quote is recorded in the HubSpot deal. The team has more time for sales by reducing calculation and recording work.

With the existing HubSpot plan

The solution handled the workflow without upgrading HubSpot or adding licenses.
